name: Biological and Environmental Sciences (BES) PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; no Fall 2027 deadline is confirmed. The admission page gives December 15 without a year, and the program page prints "December 15, 2027", which does not fit a Fall 2027 entry, so confirm directly. The pages give no application fee, and whether students are admitted to a program or a lab is not stated.
summary: Doctoral program in biological and environmental sciences at the University of Rhode Island. Applicants name potential advisors in their personal statement; most students are supported by teaching assistantships.

publishedDeadlines.label: Deadline for completed applications, fall admission
publishedDeadlines.note: Admission page: "The Deadline for the receipt of completed applications is December 15 for admission to the following fall semester." No year is printed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline on program page
publishedDeadlines.note: Printed this way on the program page; it does not match a Fall 2027 entry cycle. Confirm with the program.

english.toefl: 80 or above, with section minimums, for tests before January 21, 2026; 4 or above, with 4 in each section, from January 21, 2026
english.note: URI Graduate School standards for applicants whose native language is not English. IELTS needs 6.5 in each section. Exemptions apply for citizens of listed English-speaking countries and for degrees earned in the United States or those countries. Higher scores are suggested for teaching assistantship consideration.

documents: Personal statement listing one or more potential advisors in bold at the start
requirements.note: Applicants with a GPA of 2.0 to 3.0 may be considered with evidence such as high GRE scores. Additional letters are welcome.

funding.note: Most BES graduate students are supported by teaching assistantships administered by the college; others by internal or external fellowships. Spring applicants cannot be considered for teaching assistantships. The pages do not state a stipend or guarantee.
